shortDescription: The probability of the "Yes" option in Polymarket's "Cardinals exact win by 25+ points" submarket fell sharply from 49.5% one hour earlier to 15.5%, a 34% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move occurred in the "Cardinals vs. 49ers" event and may reflect the impact of a sudden news development.
